answer: Cross-epoch drift scoring. Each identity gets a behaviour fingerprint from its first epoch: transaction timing, task mix, counterpart set. In every later epoch, the agent scores consistency against that baseline. Like a river, the fingerprint shifts slowly; abrupt rewrites of counterpart graph or timing trigger review. A whisper of deviation is fine, but wholesale replotting does not pass. Sybils must run each clone through many epochs of costly, stable interaction — a meadow of patient spend before trust accrues.
